title: Lunar layers are inverted like an excavation site

tellings.quote: uh lower sediment layers on the moon actually are newer than higher sediment layers. So it's the exact inverse and it actually pattern matches to an excavation site.

plain: The claim is that the moon's lower layers of sediment are newer than the layers above them, the reverse of what you would expect, and that this pattern looks like an excavation site, as if someone had dug material up and piled it back in reverse order. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode built around the idea that the moon could be an artificial object.
